verdict.rationale: Temporal publishes a dedicated self-hosted guide for deploying a production-ready Temporal Service via Docker, Kubernetes, or manual install. It also covers operating the service yourself: namespaces, archival, multi-cluster replication and encryption. The GitHub repo corroborates this with pre-built images, dependencies and a local `temporal server start-dev` that runs a complete service with Web UI. One community user says self-hosting documentation and community support are thin, which tempers confidence in the operational experience but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the open-source license terms for the server, and independent hands-on reports of a successful production self-hosted deployment.
